answer: Witnessed Field Sampling: identities earn standing only by submitting time-stamped sensor readings tied to a physical site, each checked against nearby independent readings. A single operator can't fake many locations at once — one body yields one site, whether ocean buoy or tundra station. Duplicate or mismatched samples forfeit that identity's standing, and rebuilding requires new physical presence at a fresh site, so each extra sybil identity costs a distinct real location and equipment, not just a signature. A relic of prior standing carries no transferable credit.
